title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT FINDS OUT THAT, EVEN AT THE ANTIPODES, IT IS CONVENIENT TO HAVE SOME MONEY IN ONE'S POCKET
summary_hover: Passepartout wakes up on the Carnatic bound for Japan, realizes he left Fogg behind, and arrives in Yokohama penniless and hungry.
summary_detail: Awaking from his opium-induced stupor aboard the Carnatic, Passepartout discovers that Phileas Fogg and Aouda missed the ship because he failed to inform them of its early departure. Arriving in Yokohama, Japan, he finds himself alone with no money. He wanders the exotic streets of the European and Japanese quarters, growing increasingly hungry as night falls.
